messages:
Maria: Quick sync — new vuln surfaced in our base image (CVE-2025-2109). Planning a coordinated base-image rebuild + redeploy for hosted/dedicated/private. Need clarity on RBAC for the builder SA, KMS signing/rotation, and audit log retention. Who can weigh in? :eyes:

Kevin: I can help. Two quick things: 1) prefer using a KMS-backed cosign key for attestation so we don't keep private keys in CI. 2) we should grant minimum KMS permissions to the build SA only for the signing key and scope by resource.

Sasha: Agree on KMS. Ops note: for Dedicated/private customers we have to avoid key exposure from customer-managed vaults — we'll need a documented flow per deployment type. Also: we'll want terraform changes for the IAM bindings, not ad-hoc gcloud grants.

Tara: For RBAC, the builder service account only needs the ability to sign with the specific key — on GCP that's usually roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier (or a custom role with cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get and cloudkms.cryptoKeys.sign). Please provide exact permission list for the terraform module.

Kevin: Suggested least-priv policy: ["cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign", "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign", "cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get"] — wrap into custom role 'redwood.kmsCosignSigner'. We'll also add an IAM condition limiting use to the builder SA and the cosign service account used by CI.

Maria: Audit logs question: how long should we retain signing/audit logs for compliance? PCI-ish customers have asked for 1 year, security recommends 2 years. Thoughts?

Tara: Ops/SRE: 90 days for runtime logs is default; but for key usage and attestation events we should retain 2 years in cold storage (export to log-bucket + archive to BigQuery/nearline). That needs a retention policy and billing approval.

Dan: Product note: Dedicated customers will ask for maintenance windows. Can we make the rebuild a rolling process with fallback images so we avoid downtime? Also need a customer-facing heads-up.

Sasha: Plan for rolling rebuild: build -> sign -> publish to private registry -> gradual rollout via canary -> if failure revert to previously signed image. Revert requires we keep previous signed image and its SBOM + attestation.

Kevin: Example cosign commands we plan to use (CI step):

```
# sign with KMS-backed key
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-1 \  
  --annotations build=base-2025-03-01 gcr.io/redwood/base:sha256-abcdef

# generate sbom (example)
syft -o json gcr.io/redwood/base:sha256-abcdef > base-2025-03-01-sbom.json
```

Sasha: We'll also attach a build metadata manifest with git commit, builder SA, pipeline id and timestamp. attestation stored in the same registry as image signatures.

Maria: Vulnerability triage — which CVEs block the rebuild? Security suggests any RCE/privilege escalation in distro packages should trigger immediate rebuild. We have a shortlist in the vuln tracker.

Tara: Triage runbook (short):
1) Confirm exploitability in our runtime (is package reachable in final image?).
2) If exploitable, trigger critical rebuild.
3) Run canary rollout + increased monitoring for 24h.
4) If canary fails, rollback to previous signed image and open incident.

Maria: Incident flow if image replacement fails during rollout: we need a concrete rollback snippet and pager instructions.

Tara: Rollback snippet (k8s helm example):
```
# revert to previous image
helm set image base=gcr.io/redwood/base:sha256-previous -n redwood runtime-release
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n redwood
```
Pager step: page eng-oncall (primary) and eng-runtime leads. Attach signed image + sbom + attest to the incident ticket.

Kevin: One more KMS nuance — rotating the cosign key: preferred approach is create new key version, sign new images with new version, but keep old key version for verification of prior signatures. After X months, retire old versions but keep verification allowed until customers expire. This needs a policy doc.

Sasha: I'll draft the terraform change for the IAM role and the rotate policy. Will include terraform PR checklist: plan, apply in staging, sign test images, verification test, notify teams.

Maria: Can someone open the PRs (iam + ci changes + runbook) and schedule the maintenance calendar? I'll coordinate customer comms.

Sasha: I'll open the terraform PR and add the IAM binding with custom role.

Kevin: I'll submit the CI changes (cosign step + SBOM collection) and a small integration test that verifies signature verification with KMS.

Dan: I'll draft the customer-facing notice and pick maintenance windows for Dedicated customers.

attest-bot: Automated note: attestation policy check failing in staging for image gcr.io/redwood/base:sha256-abcdef — missing sbom link. CI gating blocked.

Maria: Thanks — we'll address the sbom gap in the CI change. Meeting if needed tomorrow 10am? :+1:
